loginDescription: Manage saves, follow tasks, and inspect your bot.
passwordConfigNote: Administrator credentials are managed in the server configuration.
overviewDescription: A clear view of this instance. Check current activity or start a new save.
capabilityNote: Checks local prerequisites. Availability does not guarantee network or remote service connectivity.
taskScopeNote: Active queue tasks include Bot and API submissions. Detailed progress and recent results cover web/API tasks only: kept in memory, terminal results retained for about 24 hours, lost on restart. Watch forwarding outside the queue is not included.
searchTasks: Search title, task ID, or storage
newDescription: Save media from Telegram message links to a local directory. Accepted tasks continue after you close the page.
urlsPlaceholder: One Telegram message link per line
storageNote: Capabilities belong to loaded storage instances. They do not prove remote service health. Storage credentials and configuration are not displayed.
fileNote: Read-only browsing and downloads for local storages. Known config/session/database files are protected. No deletion or file modification is offered.
routesNote: Read-only watch routes. Album collection, filters, captions, forwarding, and topic behavior remain controlled by the existing bot workflow.
preferencesNote: Read-only preferences, directories, and rules for configured Telegram users. Change them through the existing bot commands.
startupNote: The console starts after Telegram initialization. For earlier startup failures, inspect the container logs.
configurationNote: Configuration is read-only here. Apply deployment changes by editing the configuration and restarting manually.
auditNote: Up to 100 operations in memory. Cleared on restart. This is not the application's full log.
readOnlyScope: Watch routes, save settings, and deployment configuration are read-only.
title: Title
confirmCancel: Cancel this task? Partial saved files may remain. Running tasks can take time to stop.
urlsNote: One link per line. Destination paths are relative to the selected storage.
name: Name
workerNote: Including tasks waiting to finish cancellation
loadedNote: Initialized instances, not remote health checks
noLocalStorage: No listable local storage is loaded.
sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
login_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait one minute and retry.
csrf_invalid: The request could not be verified. Reload and retry.
task_creation_failed: Task preparation failed. Check the links, task type, destination, and server logs.
task_not_active: This task is no longer active. Refresh the list.
invalid_path: Invalid path. Parent traversal is not allowed.
file_unavailable: The file or directory is unavailable or protected.
internal_error: The operation failed. Check the server logs.
not_found: The requested resource was not found.
